headline: Never forget when NBA YoungBoy realized nearly 200,000 people were watching his Instagram
body: Never forget when NBA YoungBoy realized nearly 200,000 people were watching his Instagram Live and decided it was time to get off 😭😂 What started as a casual livestream turned into a moment fans still laugh about. After noticing how many people had tuned in, YoungBoy ended the broadcast moments later. Nearly 200K people wanted to see what he was doing, and he wasn’t about to put on a show for them 😂💀 Who remembers this 😂😂
